control-support.patch.scope: Sources, Benchmarks, Tests and portable Script tests only; no task, ledger or research-note changes

candidate-treatment.patch.scope: Sources, Benchmarks, Tests and portable Script tests only; no task, ledger or research-note changes

original_commits: Retained in local experiment branches; do not assume these unpublished commits are remotely available.
replay: Apply control-support.patch to base for the scalar instrument and repaired common parity tests, then candidate-treatment.patch for the candidate. Place the unchanged pre-registration.json at its recorded repository path before native recapture. Native toolchain/gates remain required; numerical reproduction uses retained exports only.

historical_release_failure.scope: Only the original common test oracle; no production change
historical_release_failure.use: Optional diagnostic after constructing either measured arm. It restores the oracle that failed both initial release checks. It is not part of either measured source snapshot.
